title: citrus × bergamia var. vulgaris
intro: Citrus × bergamia var. vulgaris, commonly known as Bergamot, is a variety of citrus plant that is widely cultivated for its essential oil, which is extracted from the rind of its fruit. Bergamot is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels, improve mood, and even help regulate blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Bergamot essential oil include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which make it useful for treating a range of skin conditions, such as acne and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Bergamot essential oil include limonene, linalool, and bergamotene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and are often used in aromatherapy and perfumery.
